summary: Drive a finite set of analytic rectangular-room modes with declared modal mass, damping and coupling rather than inferring loss from wall appearance.
objective: Build a bounded room-response instrument where a sinusoidal source excites selected modes and energy input, damping loss and integration residual remain inspectable.
example_prompts: Drive one rectangular-room mode through resonance, then stop the force and inspect its damped decay.
negative_signals: Not RT60 prediction, absorption fitting, ray tracing, calibrated SPL or a furnished-room measurement.
not_for: No wall-material-to-damping inference, broadband auralization, nonlinear acoustics or certification.

entities.name: Room and modal field
entities.guidance: Reuse the exact rigid rectangular eigenfunction as a spatial display basis; each selected mode has its own numeric coordinate q, velocity and parameters.

entities.name: Source and residual panel
entities.guidance: Show source position/coupling, drive phase, energy input, damping power and per-step equation residual.

state_contract.model: For each selected rigid-room mode j, declare positive modal mass Mj, a non-all-zero mode triplet, natural frequency fj from the rectangular-room formula, angular frequency wj=2*pi*fj, damping ratio zeta_j>=0, force amplitude Fj and spatial source coupling Phi_j(xs). Integrate Mj*qdd_j+2*zeta_j*wj*Mj*qd_j+Mj*wj^2*q_j=Fj*Phi_j(xs)*sin(Omega*t) over fixed dt with a declared method and finite step cap. Field display is sum_j q_j*Phi_j(x). The oscillator-coordinate bookkeeping energy (not calibrated acoustic energy) is Ej=.5*Mj*qd_j^2+.5*Mj*wj^2*q_j^2; its continuous balance is dEj/dt=force_j*qd_j-2*zeta_j*wj*Mj*qd_j^2. Damping is authored numeric input, not derived from wall materials.
state_contract.authority: Three.js owns modal state, fixed-step integration, force phase, energy/residual history and reset. Blender owns a dimensioned room shell, source/probe anchors and field glyph geometry.
actions: Select a finite mode set and positive room dimensions.
Sweep forcing frequency or disable forcing to observe free decay.
Change authored damping or source position and invalidate prior traces.
Step or restore an exact checkpoint.

invariants: Every active mode uses the current room dimensions, a non-all-zero nonnegative integer triplet, w=2*pi*f and declared finite modal parameters; the zero-frequency all-zero mode is rejected.
At a nodal source position the corresponding coupling is zero within tolerance.
With forcing off and nonnegative damping, accepted-step oscillator-coordinate energy cannot grow beyond the declared numerical residual tolerance; it is not calibrated acoustic energy.
Changing display gain leaves q, qdot, energy and residual unchanged.
motion_guidance: Play, pause and step advance the declared model clock only; reset restores parameters, state, solver budget, selections, errors and presentation transforms.
Use static before/after states and numeric tables for reduced motion; animation interpolates committed state and never supplies physical evidence.
creative_affordances: Blender may shape distinctive apparatus, cutaways and materials; Three.js binds named parts to authoritative state and keeps units and error states readable.
Camera, color, trails and deformation gain are presentation controls and cannot change the numerical model.
known_limits: Finite modal truncation with independent linear oscillator coordinates only; q and its bookkeeping energy have declared analog units and are not calibrated acoustic pressure or energy. No damping identification, diffuse-field assumption, wall impedance or perceptual loudness.
Authored, source-reviewed guidance only; no Blender export, numerical simulation, contact solve, browser or renderer was run.

claims.statement: A viscously damped mass-spring oscillator driven by F0 sin(omega t) satisfies m*xddot+b*xdot+k*x=F0*sin(omega*t).
claims.scope: Linear one-degree-of-freedom forced oscillator; this recipe applies the form independently to declared modal coordinates.

source_refs.locator: Section 15.6, equation 15.27 and surrounding forced damped oscillator discussion

claims.statement: Rigid rectangular-room pressure modes have cosine-product spatial shapes and natural frequencies determined by sound speed, dimensions and nonnegative integer mode indices.
claims.scope: Homogeneous lossless rectangular cavity basis only; damping and forcing are separate authored inputs.

source_refs.locator: Helmholtz rigid-boundary model, frequency formula and pressure eigenfunction

object_craft.structure: Dimension six boundary planes, source/probe anchors and sparse signed field samples; keep charts outside the acoustic domain.
object_craft.material: Use sign plus glyph shape, and label damping numerically rather than encoding it as wall roughness.

physical_contract.scope: Finite independently damped and forced rectangular-room modal coordinates.
physical_contract.timestep: Fixed declared dt and integrator; reject overflow/non-finite state and expose step residual.
state: modal mass, damping, q and qdot
checks: unforced energy non-growth within authored integrator tolerance
